axes.observation: All eight tubal meshes retain identical clean-import vertices, indices and transforms. No tested same-side contacts or nonadjacent self-contacts. Nearest fimbrial vertex-to-ovary distances shift 0.069 mm left and 0.056 mm right. Worst sampled ovarian displacement from the traced reference is 1.94 mm.

The neutral obliques and source-material views show a continuous lower pole on both interpreted ovaries. The asymmetric upper turns retain the source contour nearest each fringe. No added pits, cuts or joins appear at the 38–39 mm field.

Located the fringes beside the appropriate L/R ovary, then pointed to the visible gap from both alternate angles. Native HRA materials identify the targets and the neutral pair preserves their distinct outlines.

One selectable primitive per original leaf. Two ovary exteriors use 1,696 and 1,640 triangles; 36,051 tube triangles are retained. The same-scope GLB grows from 681,552 to 726,976 bytes. The original 424/410-triangle ovaries lose the rounded lower pole at the required close field.
